Make application composition obvious

Application rules govern the exceptional root files that assemble and start a .NET host. They keep Program.cs small, registrations layered and service-provider use explicit so startup does not become an alternative business architecture.

The value of enforcing this family

These conventions make a host easy to inspect, configure and reproduce across Web, hosted-service and command-line applications.

Choose a diagnostic below for its Standard references, architectural rationale and practical bad and good code examples.
